frontmatter.name: hermes-web-creator
frontmatter.description: Build or restyle websites using the Hermes web design system of HubPlus, with dark amber panels, white-gray-yellow light mode, Vietnamese/English navigation, responsive landing pages and article collections. Use for whole-site design and structure, rather than individual posts.

frontmatter.name: web-design-guidelines
frontmatter.description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".

nodes.label: Graphify knowledge graph workflow
nodes.rationale: Query the existing graph before source exploration to obtain a scoped subgraph; refresh graph output after code changes.

nodes.label: Nginx and Node production deployment
nodes.rationale: Use one deployment shape across hosts, varying only paths, usernames and optional server_name.

nodes.label: second-brain-data persistent volume
nodes.rationale: Persist authentication credentials and chat history at /app/data.

nodes.label: Offline bundled Windows product
nodes.rationale: Bundle Node, Hermes and initial wiki for installation without runtime downloads; generated archives and runtime binaries belong in release artifacts rather than source control.

nodes.label: Vite embedded HTTP API
nodes.rationale: Serve development API routes from the Vite process so a separate backend process is unnecessary.

nodes.label: Wiki file watching and Server-Sent Events
nodes.norm_label: wiki file watching and server-sent events

nodes.label: Read-only external Hermes wiki
nodes.rationale: App-owned auth and chat history remain outside the wiki; only the explicit Save to Wiki action delegates file creation to Hermes.

nodes.label: Unbuffered streaming proxy
nodes.rationale: Disabling nginx proxy buffering keeps graph updates and Hermes streaming responsive.

nodes.label: Product mode runtime isolation
nodes.rationale: Private Hermes home, wiki, configuration, credentials and app state keep the bundled product separate from existing Hermes installations.
